title: Substitution and quotient of the isotropy group action
summary: Given a solution of the Brent equations, a partial solution can be substituted into the Brent equations which makes it a reduced polynomial system. Then the reduced polynomial system can be solved by symbolic software, and a parameterized solution set can often be found. However, the solution set admits a positive-dimensional isotropy group action. The parameterized solution set may lie entirely in a single isotropy group orbit.
